newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Newcrest says reviewing Telfer mine.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Newcrest says reviewing Telfer mine.

text.p: Newcrest Mining Ltd said it is reviewing operations at its Telfer gold mine in Western Australia to consider the implications of continuing low grades and resultant higher costs.
Newcrest said in its report for the six months ended December 31 that rain in and around Telfer continued to adversely affect gold production at the mine.
"The impact on earnings for the second half of the year can only be quantified once road access to the mine is re-established," it said.
Newcrest did not release any immediate detail about its likely plans for Telfer.
But last October it said it planned to boost production at the mine to nearly 600,000 ounces annually within two years from 365,000 ounces in the year ended June 30 last.
Newcrest was pursuing initiatives to extend the life of Telfer, which would remain its core asset for the foreseeable future, managing director John Quinn told the annual meeting.
